baseline: FD:L1207-1213 (the single write path), FD:L1216-1218 (programmatic isolation), FD:L1321-1325 (signEligible under ProfileMutex: eligibility, identity, second check, sign the displayed bytes, send via WalletSubmit, release), FD:L4933 (WalletSubmit.submit checks keccak256(rawTx) = approvedTxHash), FD:L862 (the embedded wallet is the only source of eth_sendRawTransaction from the extension), BR14 (FD:L2691).

nodes.Wallet: wallet_req handler; one pending request, <= 5 per minute (FD:L1142); 'from' must be the account granted to (netKey, siteAddress), else 4100
nodes.Approval: approval window bound to the network and the exact bytes (D14, D26); user click
nodes.Sign: Wallet signs exactly the displayed bytes
nodes.WalletSubmit: submit(rawTx, approvedTxHash): keccak256(rawTx) == approvedTxHash, then send
nodes.Node.eth_sendRawTransaction: the write at the node (RpcTap source walletSubmit)

exits.when: 'from' is not the granted account (BR14 variant)
a wallet request is already pending, or the rate of 5/min is exceeded (P: data {reason:'pending'})
network not eligible: netKey changed or revoked, disconnected, profile conflict, RP without a successful window (FD:L982, FD:L1001, FD:L1323)
the user rejects or closes the window
identity changed while the window was open
eligibility lost while the window was open (eligibilityEpoch changed)

exitsLabel: The code per exit is P where the baseline gives only the cause; 4001, 4100 and 4901 are the baseline's codes (FD:L1226).
properties: W1: every path from Frame to Node.eth_sendRawTransaction passes Wallet, Eligibility1, Approval, Identity, Eligibility2, Sign and WalletSubmit, in this order
W2: only WalletSubmit's requests carry eth_sendRawTransaction
W3: BridgeAuth has no edge to WalletSubmit or HttpTransport (FD:L1218)
W4: no node other than HttpTransport reaches a Node.* node
